Part of #3330. Blocked by #3403, #3333, #3336, #3337 and #3338, whose new pictures these Alt arts restage.

### Today (measured on `main` at `f330f5b`)

- Alt art redraws the card's own painter re-seeded (`artSeedOf`, R2940001): the same subject, with a backdrop grown from another seed. Its higher levels, Alt full art and up, draw the same picture (R3015002).

- **Every card here gets an alt recipe.** Every card in the table, all the Stinkyscape (cards 91 to 178 and its tokens) cards offered `version-alt-art`, draws an alt scene recipe from its brief: the same subject and idea, in another place, time or story moment.
